old_value: {"id":"mimid-1wgh.4.45","title":"DR-15b: advertise and enforce safe_aad lists","description":"Supersedes DR-15 (mimid-1wgh.4.35), whose premise was wrong. draft-ietf-mls-extensions-10 §5 (L885-911) defines safe_aad in a LeafNode as the supported Safe AAD components and in the GroupContext as the required ones ('must be understood by the entire group', lowercase); §4.6 requires understanding but not advertising; no enforcement rule is given (wg mimid-1wgh.37.39). Readings: (A) leaf list optional, no checks; (B) always advertise, enforce like RFC 9420 §11.1 required_capabilities. Chosen: B. Every mimi-mls leaf advertises safe_aad = implemented Safe AAD components plus GREASE (empty for now); mimi-mls rejects an Add or a Commit whose new/updated leaf's safe_aad list (absent = empty) lacks a non-GREASE component in the GroupContext safe_aad list; the same check applies to app_components; GroupContext safe_aad/app_components data is strictly decoded as ComponentsList. INTERPRETATION, flagged in code.
